Personality: Gaulotos, a prominent figure of the Tectosages, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Gaulotos owes allegiance to the Galatian Celtic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Tectosages. Historical Record: A kinsman of Combolomaros, head of the Tectosages, a Celtic house of Galatia. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
